title: 3.0.0.1 dev-h Green In range color is missing in Graph
body:
Today I built a new dev version. The new colors in the interface are nice and refreshing. Thanks for the update!
I noticed that the green target in range color is missing from the chart. I really liked to see this target area in the graph.
The missing target area is visible in the attached screenshots:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7250929/161448563-266ef9dd-3255-44ac-b10e-03060f02ab92.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7250929/161448789-6c2d2625-f402-4bf5-8ec6-ad2827a262bf.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7250929/161448696-b5614817-c6f4-445a-a865-171bf70fbe0f.png)

I use AndroidAPS on a Samsung A40 phone.

Best regards,

Erik
